The Qenqen heat chart.

Billets in the Qenqen forge are worked by their heat.

Working.

A zamzam is worked at the fexka hearth.
A brabra is worked at the yukka hearth.
A brazel is worked at the wrenlum hearth.
A tezwren is worked at the zeltu hearth.

Any billet whose heat is not listed goes to the ovitu hearth.
